moments.title: Halloween Weekend Arrives!
moments.blurb: Halloween falls on Saturday, October 31st, with many themed events and celebrations running throughout the UK this week and over the half-term holiday.

angles.name: Family Fun

angles.name: Local Events
angles.copy: Spooky season is in full swing! From pumpkin patches to haunted trails, there are loads of Halloween events happening locally and across the UK this week. Check out what's on in your area!

moments.title: Bonfire Night Approaches

angles.name: Planning Ahead

angles.name: Safety First

moments.title: Charges in RAF Fairford Investigation
moments.blurb: Two men have been charged today (October 27th) under the National Security Act following an investigation into activity near RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire last month, with one accused of assisting a foreign intelligence service.

angles.name: National Security News
angles.copy: Breaking: Two men have been charged today under the National Security Act following an investigation into activity near RAF Fairford. A significant development in a high-profile case.

angles.name: Gloucestershire Incident
angles.copy: Further developments in the RAF Fairford investigation, with charges brought today. This follows an incident near the Gloucestershire airbase last month.
